moments.text: IR view of a small island with a lattice tower, crosshair on its right end; a disclosure notice runs along the bottom until 5 s.
A group of faint dots enters at the top right of the tower, drifts down past the island's tip, exits the bottom near 9.4 s.
The view swings down and right: the island slides off the top left, leaving plain grey water around the crosshair.
A small row of bright dots rises from the bottom left of centre to the upper left, then drifts right along the upper left.
The row drops below the crosshair and stays there as the sensor follows, four or more dots in a short line, shifting left and right.
The dots spread into a looser group of about six and slide to the lower left, briefly dipping off the bottom edge near 47 s.
A white flash, flat grey frames, blurred bright patches, a blocky glitch and a black frame at 51.9 s; hazy grey views to the end.
